rules.statement: The Courts are under a duty to scrutinize with 'close and vigilant suspicion' any transaction in which a Proctor is professionally concerned and from which he or a relative in whom he has a special interest obtains from the lay client a benefit by way of gift. The transaction, when it involves a confidential relationship between the Proctor and his client, must be presumed to have been entered into under undue influence unless the contrary can be shown.
